BL-766 — DEFECT — Mini App Let's Talk was half-retired in the working tree: steps assert a health stub the server never serves
What it solves: Do not treat the shrunken CRAP file list as cosmetic. A gate that stops
measuring a live file is the same failure shape as a test that stops
asserting: it reports green because it looks at less.
Approval context: Found by the 2026-07-31 master-diff review, not reported by any gate. Needs a decision because the two honest repairs point opposite ways:
Option A — finish the retirement: serve a health document at `/lets-talk` (`ok`, `talkClient`), retire or redirect the Mini App Let's Talk route, and update BL-…
BL-766 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-766" (or "reject BL-766 <reason>") to act.
